description: Office of the Chief Secretary - Sabaragamuwa Province Council - Declare that Mr. W. A. W. P. gunarathna as Chairman for Balangoda Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Chairman for the Balangoda Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and results at the local government level, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7). While it names an individual (Mr. W. A. W. P. Gunarathne), the primary focus is on the electoral declaration rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, which would fall under Types 2 or 3.
